{{Top|leg}}
The '''Khzrry family unit''' was once one of the most highly-respected [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]] families. After the deaths of most of the family members, the two survivors joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==History==
At some point during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], most of the Khzrry family was vacationing aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|resort liner]] ''[[Savage Pleasure]]''. The forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] killed everyone on the liner in an attempt to assassinate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mael Sidras]], leaving [[K'lial Khzrry]] and its [[Marriage/Legends|spouse]] [[Diskio Khzrry|Diskio]] as the only surviving Khzrrys.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

The pair began to travel [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], claiming to be recruiting genetically advantaged beings for possible inclusion into the Khzrry family. In fact, K'lial and Diskio, having vowed to help bring down the Empire, were agents of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. They specialized in extracting Rebel personnel who had been captured by the authorities.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives" />
